text:
sam.green: Quick question — we're planning a KEK rotation for Azure Key Vault (HSM-backed) that rewraps DEKs used for S3/GCS objects. Two high-level concerns: 1) cross-tenant user-assigned managed identity needs wrap/unwrap permissions, 2) we need reliable audit trails shipped to customer Log Analytics/archival. Anyone run into tenant RBAC gotchas or diag-settings quirks?

mira.chen: Short version: use data-plane RBAC (Key Vault Crypto* roles) for MSI. Access policies don't work well for cross-tenant/service-principal scenarios. Also ensure the service principal exists in the KV tenant and has the right role assignment.

sam.green: Example RBAC assignment I was testing — is this roughly right?

```bash
az role assignment create \\n  --assignee <MSI_PRINCIPAL_ID> \\n  --role "Key Vault Crypto User" \\n  --scope /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/my-akv
```

mira.chen: Yeah that's the pattern. For HSM-backed keys you may need "Key Vault Crypto Service Encryption User" in some scopes depending on ops you call, but usually Crypto User covers wrap/unwrap. Also: if the MSI originates in another tenant, create a service principal in the target tenant (guest SP) or use federated identity (AADC/Azure AD) — otherwise the principal won't be recognized.

kai.lopez: On the logging side — enable diagnostic settings on the vault. Send "AuditEvent"/"KeyVaultAuditEvents" to Log Analytics + optionally Event Hub for long-term retention. Note that the logs will show operations (wrapKey/unwrapKey) with key id and principal id, but not DEK plaintext (as expected). Make sure you have Retention and table schemas (AzureDiagnostics) set up.

sam.green: What's the exact az command to wire diag settings to a workspace?

kai.lopez: Something like this:

```bash
az monitor diagnostic-settings create \\n  --resource /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/my-akv \\n  --name kv-diags \\n  --workspace /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/my-la \\n  --logs '[{"category":"AuditEvent","enabled":true},{"category":"KeyVaultAuditEvents","enabled":true}]'
```

mira.chen: A couple of gotchas we've hit:
- If you switch a vault from access policies -> RBAC, there's a short window where older audit events may still reference access-policy principals; double-check principal ids.
- Diagnostic settings are per-vault; creating them via ARM/TF at provisioning time avoids drift.
- For cross-tenant MSIs, AD consent/guest SP creation must be handled in advance or role assignments will silently fail.

sam.green: Rotation strategy question: do we need to rewrap all DEKs immediately when KEK rotates? That could be huge.

mira.chen: Not necessarily — common patterns:
- Lazy rewrap: rewrap on first access (lowest immediate load).
- Background rewrap job: orchestrated worker pool that rewraps objects in batches, respecting throttling.
- Versioned envelope keys: store KEK version id alongside ciphertext so old KEKs remain usable until all rewraps finish.
Keep KEK versions around (don't disable/delete old KEK immediately).

kai.lopez: Also store metadata in object header: { kek_kid: "https://.../keys/mykey/<version>", wrapped_key_version: "v2" }. That makes rollbacks/forensics easier.

sec-bot: IncidentBot: Detected 1 failed wrapKey operation for principal "servicePrincipal:abc123" against key "my-akv-key" in the last 24h. Failure: 403 Forbidden.

ops-oncall: 403 usually means missing data-plane RBAC. Double-check the principal id used in the token (msi vs guest-sp). If rotation job hits 403 en masse, ensure jobs retry with backoff and retain old KEK until all objects rewrapped. Add runbook: emergency rewrap using a fallback principal that we pre-provision with a locked-down role.

sam.green: Great — action items I'm taking: 1) create RBAC assignment for the cross-tenant MSI and verify via `az keyvault key show` using its token, 2) enable diag settings to LA & export to EH, 3) add kek_kid metadata to object headers, 4) implement staged background rewrap job + keep old KEK versions enabled until completion. I'll open an RFC + runbook PR. Thanks all. :rocket:
